correctness.rationale: In each H-eigenspace the subspace orthogonal to the sink reduces H and is unaffected by loss. On the orthogonal complement every eigenvalue has strictly negative imaginary part: the imaginary part of the eigenvector's Rayleigh quotient is -kappa times the squared sink overlap divided by twice its squared norm, and a zero overlap would give an H-eigenvector in the omitted dark sector. Jordan polynomial factors still decay, so the surviving norm is the initial dark weight. Plane waves with layer signs ± have energies 2g c_j±t and overlap magnitudes 1/sqrt(2p) at each rung endpoint; one endpoint acquires the relative minus sign. At an energy with multiplicities a,b their dark weight is [(a+b)-(a-b)^2/(a+b)]/(2p) = (2/p)ab/(a+b). Only cross-band energy equalities contribute; the sign of g swaps the band labels but not the set of positive t or weights. For prime p any rational relation of the cosines corresponds to a polynomial of degree at most p-1 vanishing at a primitive p-th root, hence its coefficients are all in the ratio prescribed by Phi_p. The cosine relation vector is proportional to (1/2,1,...,1), whose coordinate sum is nonzero. Thus equality of two ordered positive gaps, with zero-sum coefficient vector, forces identical pairs. The multiplicity products (1,2) and (2,2) yield 4/(3p) and 2/p; p=3 has just the first case, at 3|g|/2. A unit cosine gap would give e_a-e_b-e_0 proportional to the positive relation vector, impossible by sign or support, so t=|g| is off resonance. All statements use positive sink rate; none assumes normality of the loss generator.
residual_risks: Finite precision eigenspace grouping can merge very close distinct energies. The archived spot checks are corroboration, not the proof of gap isolation or infinite-time decay. No claim for composite p, a different detector, or finite-time resonance widths.

evidence: The physical projection principle is general; exact applications include an open ladder corner sink, a prime four-regular circulant, and odd-prime cycle-product tori with rational rate ratio.

evidence: The earlier unweighted prism proof exhausts cosine adjacency gaps of size 2, requiring 4 or 6 to divide the cycle length. The torus proof explicitly states rational affine independence of prime-cycle levels and uses a bright-vector projector.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The unweighted equal-magnitude corollary is already implied (odd primes satisfy neither divisibility; in a noncolliding parity eigenspace the two endpoint projections agree up to sign). Affine independence gives gap uniqueness without further arithmetic novelty. To classify all positive real t and obtain the starting-site-specific weights still requires the tunable prism's genuine cross-band collision decomposition and its opposite-sign multiplicity calculation; neither source gives that classification.

evidence: Razzoli et al. give the generic trap-visible subspace. The average-mixing record addresses the same geometry at unit weights. The prime-torus record uses the same no-jump protocol and cosine arithmetic but both factors are prime cycles of size at least five and anisotropy is rational.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Passage from efficiency to survival is just complementation and is credited. Neither the unweighted unitary average nor the rational-coupling odd-prime torus is an equivalent statement of the weighted two-ring opposite-rung theorem.

originality.rationale: The supported distinct result is the complete positive real rung-coupling classification with exact opposite-rung trapped weights on a prime prism. The generic bright-sector formula is established; the prime cosine gap uniqueness follows directly from a relation also present in the prime-torus comparison, and the unweighted zero-survival corollary follows from the earlier unweighted-prism collision proof and the generic sink formula. Those components are not credited as separate original results.
residual_risks: A dedicated literature lookup was unavailable; no absence is inferred from that. A publication explicitly evaluating the same tunable prism could change the originality assessment.

value.rationale: The measured invariant is the actual fraction surviving from the opposite end of a rung, not just whether the graph has dark modes. The exact finite set and two weights give a complete diagram for a natural single-sink periodic model and show that generic perfect capture coexists with isolated positive surviving fractions. This goes beyond the already implied unweighted case.
residual_risks: The discontinuity is for the infinite-time limit and is not a finite-time robustness or engineering claim.
